subject: Fix cluster test module to pass null terminated node-id to SendClusterMessage (#2484)
reason: The change only modifies the test module tests/modules/cluster.c, null-terminating sender_id before passing it to ValkeyModule_SendClusterMessage. On both the change's build and its parent, the server already delivers sender_id to module cluster-message receivers as a null-terminated sds (sdsnewlen at cluster_legacy.c:3337), so strlen in clusterSendModuleMessageToTarget reads the same 40 bytes either way and the module behaves identically on both builds: same replies, same DONG delivery, no crash possible.
